description: Audits an MCP server or GitHub repository for security vulnerabilities (CWE-78 Command Injection, CWE-798 Secret Leaks, CWE-22 Path Traversal, CWE-306 Missing Auth). Returns Trust Score (0-100), Letter Grade, and remediation steps.

target.description: GitHub repository URL (e.g. "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers") or public MCP endpoint URL to audit.

name: audit_mcp_security
